login.title: Injira y'umufatanyabikorwa
login.welcome: Murakaze mugarutse! Injira kugira ngo ucungere abarongozi bawe.
login.heroTitle: Gukura ubucuruzi bwawe bw'amazu n'uburongozi bwose uzana
login.heroIntro: Urubuga rumwe rwo kwandika abakiriya n’abubatsi, kugumya inguzanyo y’abarongozi bawe no kubakurikira gushika aho bafata amatike.

protect.title: Uburinzi bwisubiriza
protect.text: Ivyo urongora biguma ari ivyawe mu kiringo cose c’uburinzi, rero nta wundi ashobora kwitwaza umukiriya umwe.

track.title: Gukurikirana intambwe yose
track.text: Raba ikibanza c’umurongozi wese n’amateka yose, kuva ku guhura kwa mbere gushika ku gutora.

handover.title: Inguzanyo mu gutora
handover.text: Iyo umukiriya akora igitabu, uburongozi bushikirizwa uwuwukora kandi wewe wanditswe nk’umufatanyabikorwa w’inkomoko.

login.secure: Kwinjira mu mutekano - amakuru y'abaguzi bawe aguma ari ay'ibanga

signup.title: Ukwandikisha kw'abafatanyabikorwa
signup.intro: Rema konti yawe kugira utangure kwandika no gucunga abarongozi bawe bwite.
